responses_fitted: All eight original response columns, in their stored units and full float64 precision

design_cases.physical_cells: Actual B2:D20 values unchanged; primary cell-coordinate fit

affine_from_cells.evidence: Five repeated center settings and the first eight factorial settings

table6_rounded_alpha.source: Pereira et al. (2025), Table 6, PDF page 18; factor columns in printed row order
table6_rounded_alpha.squares: Recomputed by the complete quadratic basis, not copied from rounded printed squares

rotatable_alpha_hypothesis.source: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook section 5.3.3.6.1, Table 3.23 and alpha formula

beta_mapping_evidence: Seven responses match all ten coefficients under the explicitly diagnostic scale and nominal rotatable design; not an independent confirmation of physical coding constants
rounding_policy: Half a unit in the last printed decimal, inclusive ties, plus 16*float64_eps*max(1,abs(calculated),abs(published)) solely for numerical boundaries
lossy_WR_diagnostic: Optional post-hoc copy rounded to 3 decimals; all 19 observations would change. Excluded from actual fits and validation totals. Does not prove author preprocessing.
